output.scope_note: The paper reports Li-ion conductivities of PVDF-HFP-based solid polymer electrolytes containing trace residual solvent, so it falls within solid Li-ion conductors.

records.evidence_quote: 5.5 × 10⁻⁴ S cm⁻¹ for TFOMA versus 1.0 × 10⁻⁴ S cm⁻¹ for TFDMA. Above 70 °C, the TFOMA system exceeds 10⁻³ S cm⁻¹
records.evidence_location: Electrochemical Performance Testing and Mechanistic Analysis (results)
records.notes: TFOMA is a trace residual solvent (~0.1 µL) in a PVDF-HFP matrix. Activation energy 0.29 eV is from the same paper's Arrhenius fit (text: 'activation energies of 0.29 eV (TFOMA) and 0.45 eV (TFDMA)'). Measurement method (EIS) not stated explicitly.
